decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Sufficient details of floodlighting have been provided in relation to the large retail food store only in order for the Council to be satisfied that neighbours' living conditions will have been adequately protected in accordance with the planning permission and adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-P.1.6 (Air Pollution).

Informative:  These details apply to the large retail food store (ASDA) only.  Prior to first occupation of the proposed A3 unit, the Health Club and the medical centre and the housing, details under this condition will need to be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council for all of these uses where necessary.
description: Following approval for demolition of existing houses, social club & some retail premises and the comprehensive redevelopment of Key Site 1 with the erection of a mixed use development comprising multiplex cinema, leisure and recreational facilities, town square, large retail unit, shops, restaurants, offices, hotel, health and fitness centre, creche, medical and dentistry centre, private residential and key worker residential, together with improvments to surrounding access routes and improvements to public transport including a new pedestrian link to Hounslow Central Undergound Station and the construction of two new road links between the site and the high street, and the construction of car parks, access and service roads and landscaping. details submitted pursuant to condition 29 (Details of lux levels, direction and screening of flood lights) following planning permission 00616/F/P5 dated 31/07/02.
